title: store
description: Records compressed media to disk as continuous segments, event clips, or both, and registers each file as a ZoneMinder event with zm-api.

mode.description: Recording mode; unknown values fall back to continuous.

root.description: Directory media is written under; defaults to /Shared/zm/media on macOS, C:/ZM/media on Windows and /lib/zm/media elsewhere.

monitor_id.description: Monitor id used in file paths and clip tokens.

max_secs.description: Continuous mode: segment length in seconds before rotating at the next keyframe.

pre_roll_sec.description: Event mode: seconds of media kept before the trigger.

post_roll_sec.description: Event mode: seconds recorded after the last trigger.

max_buffer_sec.description: Event mode: rolling buffer cap in seconds; raised to pre_roll_sec + 2 if smaller than pre_roll_sec.

trigger_types.description: Event types that start or extend a clip; empty means motion, detection, audio_event and tracked_detection.

stream_filter.description: Stream ids to record; empty records every stream.
